ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: GoFix uses your photos for your profile photo, your cover image and your supporting documents.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: GoFix uses the camera for your profile photo and your supporting documents.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GoFix uses your location only when you ask it to: to find the nearest professionals, suggest your wilaya or, if you are a professional, set your starting point.
